blocks.text: Welcome to **SymphonyCSV Studio — the DAW before the DAW.**
SymphonyCSV Studio is a new music composition environment where musical ideas become readable, editable CSV files.
Compose, experiment, audition, and shape your music before taking it into a traditional Digital Audio Workstation—or export your music directly as a finished recording.

items: **Six synchronized musical tracks:** Two Piano Roll tracks, two Guitar TAB tracks, and two Drum tracks.
**Realistic guitar performances:** Unlike traditional piano-roll notation, our Guitar TAB format models string-specific performances, including chords, strumming, and expressive playing techniques.
**Three SymphonyCSV formats:** Work directly with structured CSV files representing pitched instruments, guitar performances, and drums.
**SoundFont instruments:** Audition compositions with sampled instruments and percussion.
**Creative effects:** Shape your music with Chorus, Delay, Reverb, and a Master Compressor.
**Five-Band Master Graphic EQ:** Fine-tune your entire mix, from deep bass to sparkling highs.
**High-quality audio exports:** Download stereo WAV recordings or 320 kbps MP3 files.
**MIDI export:** Take your compositions into other music applications.
**Portable Projects:** Save your composition, settings, and supported SoundFont assets together in a Project ZIP.
**Local-first privacy:** Your musical files are processed in your browser, not uploaded to a server.

blocks.text: **LABS is our experimental development environment.** SymphonyCSV Studio is functional and evolving. Some features are still being developed, and you may encounter limitations as we improve the application.
Please keep copies of your original files and exported Project ZIPs. Browser storage can be cleared, and externally supplied SoundFonts may have redistribution restrictions.
You don’t need to be a programmer to explore SymphonyCSV. You can edit your music in a spreadsheet, work directly with the CSV files, or collaborate with an AI assistant to develop musical ideas.

messages.title: Getting Started Tip: Turn MIDI into Your Own Composition

blocks.text: **Have a MIDI file? Let’s turn it into music you can edit!**

items: Open the **Import MIDI** workspace in SymphonyCSV Studio.
Drag and drop a `.mid` or `.midi` file to convert it into SymphonyCSV.
**Download the CSV** and open it in a text editor or spreadsheet. Explore how notes, timing, velocities, and other musical details are represented.
**Make it your own!** Change some notes, adjust velocities, or experiment with the timing. Save your edited CSV.
Open **Track 1 — Piano Roll** and drag your CSV into the track.
Press **Play** and hear your changes come to life!

blocks.text: **Congratulations! You’ve just started composing with SymphonyCSV.**
Your music is now readable, editable data. You can even ask an AI assistant to help you develop your composition.
